user.title: Add an HA Slate panel
user.description: Enter the panel's address. Panels on the same network are discovered automatically.

pair.title: Pair with {name}
pair.description:
Certificate fingerprint: {fingerprint}…

If the panel came with a pairing code label, enter it. Otherwise leave it empty: a new or factory-reset panel accepts pairing for 15 minutes after power-on.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-pair the panel
reauth_confirm.description: The panel no longer accepts Home Assistant's credentials (it was factory reset or its certificate changed). Power-cycle it and pair again.

error.locked: Too many wrong codes. Wait a minute and try again.
error.pairing_window_closed: The pairing window has closed. Power-cycle the panel and try again within 15 minutes.
error.already_paired: The panel is paired with another Home Assistant. Factory reset it first.

abort.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different panel.

sync_wake_words.name: Sync wake words
sync_wake_words.description: Push the models in config/custom_wake_words to every HA Slate panel (and remove ones that were deleted).
